What we do

Four ways to leave a lasting impression - from boardrooms and weddings to festivals and the wrapping counter.

01Corporate Gifting
Sophisticated, brand-aligned executive hampers, festival kits, and luxury gifts designed to make a lasting impression on clients and partners.
02Events & Celebrations
Custom favor hampers, grand-scale packaging, and elegant trousseau packing for weddings, anniversaries, baby showers, and milestones.
03Festive Hampers

The Art of Premium Gifting

Nestled in the luxurious ambiance of the Radisson Blu, Wrap & Gift is a premier gifting boutique. We believe that a gift is more than just an item-it is an art form and a reflection of your finest sentiments. Every hamper we curate is meticulously planned-from selecting fine products to incorporating elegant textures and personalized details. We offer a seamless pre-ordering process for large corporate demands or massive event timelines.
